blogs.title: Tasty Sesame Chicken Noodles Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken noodles made with a touch of sesame flavor. It tastes so delicious and is so fast to make as well.

 

Sesame Chicken Noodles Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Egg Noodles - 1 packet

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large sliced

Soy sauce to taste

Vinegar to taste

Sugar to taste

Salt to taste

Spring Onion - a handful chopped finely

Sesame Seeds as needed

 

FOR MARINATION:

Chicken - 300 grams boneless

Ginger garlic paste - 1 tablespoon

Soy Sauce - 2 teaspoon

Black pepper powder - 1 teaspoon

Cornflour - 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Cook noodles as per packet instructions. Drain and set aside.

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients and mix well. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pan. Add in onions and fry for a min.

Add in chicken and cook till golden.

Add in noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Mix well.

Stir fry for few mins.

Add in spring onion. Mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Stir-fried Chicken in Black Bean and Black Pepper Sauce Recipe
blogs.title_hi: ब्लैक बीन और काली मिर्च सॉस सॉस में टेस्टी स्टिर-फ्राइड चिकन
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken cooked in a spicy black bean and pepper sauce. This tastes amazing with noodles or fried rice. It is not only delicious but fast to make as well.

When I was looking for dinner inspiration online, I came across a picture of a spicy chicken served with some noodles. I got so inspired by that so I made it almost immediately.

This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier.

 

Stir Fry Chicken in Black Bean & Black Pepper Sauce

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

For Chicken:-

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams cut into small pieces

Soy Sauce - 2 teaspoons

Vinegar - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Sugar - ¼ teaspoon

Cornflour - 2 tablespoon

Oil - 4 tablespoon

 

For Sauce:-

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Ginger - 1 teaspoon chopped

Onion - 1 chopped

Spring Onion - 1 chopped

Black Bean Sauce - 2 tablespoon

Water as needed

Black pepper powder to taste

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with all ingredients.

Heat oil in a pan. Add in chicken and saute till golden.

Remove it to a plate.

Heat oil in a pan. Add ginger, onions and spring onion.

Add in sauce and saute for a min.

Add in water and mix well.

Add chicken back in and cover. Cook for 5 to 8 mins.

Add in pepper powder and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken in Yogurt Sauce Recipe
blogs.content:
Dahi chicken is very easy to make. This goes well with pulao or roti. This tastes amazing and is easy to make.

 

Chicken in Yogurt Sauce

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - ½ kg

Yogurt / Curd - ¾ cup

Chilli powder - 1 tablespoon

Kashmiri chili powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder - ½ teaspoon

Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Ghee - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Seeds - 1 teaspoon

Kasuri methi leaves - 2 tablespoon

Coriander leaves - a handful finely chopped

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with yogurt and spices. Leave to marinate for 30 mins.

Heat ghee in a pan, add in cumin seeds and let them sizzle.

Add chicken and mix well for 5 mins.

Now add in little water. Cover and cook chicken for 20 to 25 mins.

Once the chicken is cooked, add in Kasuri methi leaves and coriander leaves.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Kali Mirch Murgh ( Black Pepper Chicken ) Kebab Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट काली मिर्च मुरग (काली मिर्च चिकन) कबाब रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Kali Mirch Kebab is a very humble recipe, it needs just a handful of ingredients but the taste is spectacular. This pepper kebab is so good.

Black Pepper Kebab Recipe - Kali Mirch Murgh Kebab Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams cubed

Black Pepper Powder - 1 tablespoon to 2 tablespoons

Yogurt / Curd - ½ cup

Cream - ¼ cup

Cornflour - 1 tablespoon

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Kasuri Methi Leaves - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients except oil. Let it marinate for 1 hour to overnight.

Heat oil in a pan. Drop chicken in and cook on medium-low heat for 3 to 4 mins on each side.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Couscous  With Sumac Chicken And Butter Mushrooms Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन और मक्खन मशरूम पकाने की विधि के साथ स्वादिष्ट
blogs.content:
This is a Moroccan themed lunch made using couscous and chicken. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

 

Couscous with Sumac Chicken and Mushrooms

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Morocco

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Couscous - 1 cup

Sultanas - ¼ cup

Cayenne Powder - 1 tsp

Cumin Powder - 1 tsp

Salt to taste

Hot Water - 2 cups

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken Breast - 2

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

salt to taste

Sumac Powder - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice as needed

Olive Oil - 2 tablespoons

FOR MUSHROOMS:

Butter - 1 tablespoon

Garlic - 3 cloves chopped

Mushrooms - 1 cup chopped

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Marinate chicken with the ingredients given for 2 hours.

Mix couscous with all ingredients in a bowl. Pour over hot water, cover and cook for 15 mins till all water is absorbed. Set aside.

Heat butter in a pan, add garlic and stir fry for a min,

Add in mushrooms and mix well.

Season with salt and pepper. Cook till brown and set aside.

Now in the same pan, place chicken and cook for 5 to 6 mins on each side. Add little water and cook covered for 10 mins on low heat.

Serve over couscous.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Burger Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन बर्गर पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
The delicious and juicy chicken burger which is not only tasty but is super easy to make. This burger makes a great lunch or dinner.

The super delicious spicy burger which is perfect to pack in a lunch box or taste amazing for dinner too.

 

Chicken Burger Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 burger

 

Ingredients

Minced Chicken - 500 grams

Olive oil - 1 tablespoon + more for frying

Onion - 1 small chopped finely

Capsicum / Bell Pepper - ¼ cup chopped finely

Garlic - 3 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 1 chopped finely

Egg - 1

Breadcrumbs - ½ cup

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Coriander Leaves - ½ cup chopped finely

Mayonnaise as needed

Tomato Ketchup as needed

Onions - 1 sliced

Tomato - 1 sliced

Burger Buns as needed

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan, add onions, capsicum, chilies, garlic and saute for a min.

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients except oil and mix well.

Shape it into a ball and flatten it into patties.

Heat oil in a pan, add in patties and cook for 3 to 4 mins on each side.

Take burger buns, split open, spread mayo and ketchup.

Place patties and top with sliced onions and tomatoes.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Cakes Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन केक पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Chicken cakes that taste so delicious with ketchup or mayo. This chicken cake is so easy to make and taste fantastic.

These delicious chicken cakes is super easy to make and taste amazing. You can make this in a few minutes and kids will love this for sure.

 

Chicken Cakes Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Chicken - 1 cup

Onion - 4 tablespoons chopped finely

Capsicum / Bell Pepper - 4 tablespoons chopped finely

Coriander leaves - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Mayonnaise - 3 tablespoons

Egg - 1

Breadcrumbs - ½ cup

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Oil - as needed

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients together to a smooth mix.

Heat oil in a pan, add small dollops in and cook till golden brown.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Broasted Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Broasted chicken is easy to make. This fried chicken recipe is so perfect which gives you a similar one to KFC fried chicken and it tastes amazing with garlic sauce.

 

Broasted Chicken Recipe - Chicken Broast Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil for deep frying

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken with skin and bones - 1 whole chicken cut into 12 pieces

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice or vinegar - 1 tablespoon

FOR FLOUR COATING:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 cups

Cornflour - ¾ cup

Garlic powder - 2 tablespoons

Dried Parsley - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano - 2 tablespoons

Dried Basil - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

FOR EGG:

Egg - 2

Water - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with salt, pepper, and vinegar and set aside.

Take flour in a bowl along with all ingredients given together. Set aside.

Take an egg, salt, water in a bowl and whisk well.

Now take chicken, coat in flour, then dip in egg and then coat in flour. Pack it well.

Set aside in a plate to dry for 5 mins.

Heat oil in a pressure cooker, drop the chicken in and fry for 30 seconds to 45 seconds.

Cover the cooker and pressure cook for 1 or 2 whistles.

Now switch off the flame and let it sit for 5 mins.

Now release the pressure carefully by lifting the whistle with a spoon.

Now open the cooker, and heat it again and fry till the outer layer gets crispy again.

Now drain it and serve hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Black Pepper Chicken Fry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट काली मिर्च चिकन फ्राई रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious juicy and crispy black pepper chicken fry which tastes amazing. You can serve it as a side or as an appetizer for any parties.

 

Black pepper chicken fry recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

Ingredients

Boneless chicken - 500 grams cubed

Coarsely Ground Black Pepper - 1 to 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice or Vinegar - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Leaves - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Ginger Garlic paste - 2 tablespoons

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ¼ cup

Cornflour - ¼ cup

Oil for deep frying

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients except oil.

Marinate for 30 mins to 1 hour.

Drop-in hot oil and fry till golden.

Drain and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Egg Scramble ( Leftover ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी चिकन एग स्क्रैम्बल (बचे हुए) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Quick and easy chicken egg scramble which not only taste amazing but takes only 5 mins to make. Easy and fast lunch or breakfast.

 

Chicken Egg Scramble Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Breakfast

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Capsicum - ¼ chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 chopped finely

Cooked chicken - 1 cup shredded

Eggs - 2

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan.

Add onion, chilies, and capsicum and stir for a min.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add eggs and mix well.

Season with salt and pepper and mix well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Uppu Kari ( Dozhu Uppukari ) Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन उप्पू कारी ( दोझू उप्पूकारी ) रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Chicken uppu kari or Kozhi Uppu kari is an easy and tasty side dish which can be made in a few mins. It needs just basic ingredients and tastes amazing.

 

Chicken Uppu Kari Recipe

 

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 45 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams cut into small pieces

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon + 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Garam masala powder - 2 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - 1 teaspoon

Coconut Oil - 4 tablespoon

Dry Red Chilli - 5 broken

Curry Leaves - a handful

Onion - 1 chopped

Pepper powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander leaves - ¼ cup chopped

 

Instructions

Take chicken, salt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chilli and garam masala powder in a pan. Add little water and cook till chicken is done.

Heat coconut oil in a pan, add in curry leaves, dry red chillies and fry for a min.

Add onions and ginger-garlic paste and mix well.

Add chicken and toss well. Cook for 5 to 7 mins.

Add in pepper powder and mix well. Finally, add coriander leaves too.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Pita Bread Salad Bowl Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट पाव रोटी ब्रेड सलाद बाउल रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This pita bread salad bowl is filling and tastes amazing. It has all the elements you need. The pita bread is crunchy and the veggies are fresh and the sauce is tangy.

 

Pita Bread Salad Bowl Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Salad

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Pita bread - 2

Onion - 1 sliced

Cooked Chicken - ½ cup

Tomato - 1 deseeded and chopped

Cucumber - 1 chopped

 

FOR SAUCE:

Mayonnaise - ¼ cup

Yogurt - ¼ cup

Garlic - 2 teaspoons grated

Salt to taste

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Pepper Powder - ½ teaspoon

 

Instructions

Mix all sauce ingredients. Set aside in the fridge till needed.

Take pita bread. Cut into triangles. Pop that in a baking sheet and bake in a 150 degree C oven for 12 to 15 mins till it is golden. Set aside to cool.

Now take the pita chips in a bowl, top with onions, cooked chicken, tomatoes and cucumber and pour some sauce on top.

Serve immediately.

blogs.title: Tasty zafrani ( Saffron ) Chicken Pulao Recipe
blogs.content:
This is a delicious zafrani chicken pulao which is super easy to make and taste amazing. It is great for any party.

Pulao or biryani comes handy when coming to lunch box recipes. This recipe goes perfect with some raita, I served it with onion raita. You can enjoy yourself with any raita of choice. You will need a handful of ingredients to make this pulao and it comes together in less than 40 mins.

 

Zafrani Chicken Pulao Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time

55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Basmati Rice - 2 cups

Chicken - 1 kg

Yogurt - 1 cup

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Oil - ½ cup

Cardamom - 10

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 piece

Star anise - 1

Cumin Seeds - 1 teaspoon

Onion - 3 large sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 10

Mint Leaves - ½ cup chopped

Coriander Leaves - ½ cup chopped

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

Water - 3 cups

Saffron a pinch

Warm Milk - 4 tablespoons

Rose Essence a few drops

Kewra essence few drops

Ghee - 4 tablespoons

Cashews - 10

Kishmish - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Soak basmati rice for 30 mins. Set aside.

Mix chicken with yogurt, salt, and ginger garlic paste. Set aside.

Soak saffron in warm milk and set aside.

Heat oil in a large pot. Add spices.

Add in onions and chilies and cook till golden brown.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute for a min.

Add in chicken and stir fry for 8 to 10 mins.

Add in mint and coriander leaves and mix well.

Add in rice and mix well.

Add water, salt, garam masala powder and cook till most of the water is gone.

Now add in saffron milk. Fry nuts and kishmish in ghee and pour that over rice. Add kewra and rose essence. 

Cover this and cook on low heat as possible for 5 mins.

Turn off the heat and let it stand for 10 mins.

Fluff up the rice and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe
blogs.content:
Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is one of my favorite. This hardly takes a few minutes to cook. The cool thing about this recipe is you can add whatever spices and herbs you wish in the meatballs. Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is easy to customize as per your taste.

The sauce coating the meatballs is sweet and garlicky. You could add some chili flakes in them if you want some kick. But when making for kids, it is best to avoid it so that they can enjoy it too.

 

Here are few tips for getting perfect, tender and juicy chicken meatballs.

 

1) Add bread soaked in some milk for adding moisture.

2) Don't over mix the meatballs.

3) Don't over fry the meatballs.

4) You could add some water into the meatballs mixture to make it juicy.

5) Grind half chicken breast and half chicken thighs for added moisture.

6) Adding onions and peppers will add moistness to the meatballs.

 

I hope you will love this recipe and let me know if you try it.

Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

For Meatballs :

Minced Chicken - 250 grams

Chilli Powder - ½ teaspoon

Pepper Powder - ½ teaspoon

Coriander Leaves - 2 tablespoons finely chopped

Green Chilli - 1 teaspoon finely chopped

Parmesan Cheese - ½ cup grated

Bread - 1 slice

Milk - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Italian Seasoning - 1 teaspoon

 

FOR SAUCE:

Oil - 1 tablespoon 

Garlic - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Tomato Ketchup - ¼ cup

Vinegar - 2 tablespoons 

Sugar - 2 tablespoons 

Soy Sauce - 2 tsp

Water - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for meatballs. Heat oil in a pan. Add meatballs and fry till golden. Remove to a plate.

In the same Kadai. Add in oil and saute some garlic. 

Add in ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water.

Bring it to a boil and cook till syrupy.

Now add in meatball and mix well.

Serve it.

 

Notes

1) You can add any spices or herbs in the meatballs. It is your choice.

2) The garlic in the sauce is what makes this so tasty. So add as much garlic as possible.

3) You can make this and store it in the fridge for up to a week.

4) Adding sesame seeds will make this more appealing and adds a nice crunch.

 

Nutrition Information

Serving size: 74 grams Calories: 150 Fat: 9g Saturated fat: 3g Carbohydrates: 2g Sodium: 500mg Protein: 13g

blogs.title: Tasty Thai Sausage Fried Rice Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट थाई सॉसेज फ्राइड राइस रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Thai Sausage Fried Rice Recipe is one of the easiest and tastiest recipes you could ever make with leftover rice.  You are definitely going to love my schezwan fried rice.

Fried rice is not only delicious to eat but it makes a perfect lunch box recipe too.

 

Tips to make the best-fried rice.

1) Always use cooled rice, fridge cold rice is best.

2) Cook rice a day in advance and store in the fridge, This rice is best for fried rice.

3) Always cook fried rice in high heat.

4) Serve fried rice piping hot.

 

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Thai Sausage Fried Rice

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Thai

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Rice - 3 cups

Oil - 3 tablespoon

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Garlic - 1 tablespoon chopped finely

Chicken Sausage - 3 chopped

Fish Sauce - 1 teaspoon

Soy Sauce - to taste

White Pepper to taste

Egg - 3

Vinegar - to taste

Spring onion as needed

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan, add in onion, garlic and saute for a min.

Add in chicken sausage and cook till brown.

Spread it to the side and add in beaten eggs and scramble it well.

Add fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well.

Add in cooked rice and toss well.

Add in pepper and mix well.

Add in vinegar and white pepper and toss well.

Serve it.
